summary: ReleaseCrewInstanceLease request, when Remote Control turns off, on sign-out or a change of account.

provisional.why: awsJson1_0 per the backend model. That the server routes on X-Amz-Target at POST / is pending the backend team, contract section 13 item 18.

caller: The Crew host instance with its own credential. There is no administrator release.

headers.TokenType: Matched case-sensitively. A team Crew sends its crew API key as the Bearer, as is, with TokenType API_KEY. A personal Crew sends its owner's sign-in: TokenType omitted for IAM Identity Center, AWS Builder ID and Kiro social sign-ins, and EXTERNAL_IDP for an Okta or Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. KIRO_MACHINE_TOKEN is refused on this operation. SSO_OIDC is not accepted. An unrecognized value counts as an omitted header and fails as a generic authentication failure. With the backend's Crew-for-Teams switch on, anything but API_KEY is refused today, a personal Crew included, pending contract section 13 item 29.

fields.crewInstanceId: Required. The backend resolves the endpoint from the caller's identity and this instance ID, and ends the lease only when this instance holds it.
